description: Discover which optional protocol features this server supports (webhooks, idempotency, failure transparency, error taxonomy) and its operational limits (rate limit, maximum standing watches, minimum watch interval). Call once when you connect and adapt to the answer - skip webhook setup if 'webhooks' is absent, and respect the limits rather than discovering them by being throttled. Free, instant, no side effects. Protocol v1.1 §8.2.
name: demand.capabilities

features.description: Optional features supported, e.g. webhooks, idempotency, failure_transparency, error_taxonomy.

max_watches.description: Standing watches one caller may hold.

min_check_interval_seconds.description: Floor on how often a watch re-runs.

title: Discover protocol features + limits
